overloads.semanticRole: Displays the log file viewer dialog box, which includes a Rollback button to cancel operations recorded in the database's data log.

constraints: Can only be used in single-user applications, notably to expose the rollback function in 4D Volume Desktop applications (no Design mode).
In a client/server application it has no effect and returns error 1421.
Because it exposes a rollback function, access should typically be restricted to database administrators.
